claim.claim-text: 1. An airfoil structure for a gas turbine engine comprising:
an airfoil including a leading edge and a trailing edge; and a platform located adjacent a first end of the airfoil, and including:
2. The airfoil structure of claim 1, further comprising an inlet to the core passage located on a radially inner side of the platform axially upstream of the core passage spaced from the airfoil.
3. The airfoil structure of claim 1 or 2, wherein at least one of the set of impingement cooling holes is located downstream of the trailing edge of the airfoil.
4. The airfoil structure of any preceding claim, wherein the mate-face is located on a pressure side of the platform.
5. The airfoil structure of any of claims 1 to 3, wherein the mate-face is located on a suction side of the platform.
6. The airfoil structure of any preceding claim, wherein the airfoil includes at least one cooling passage in communication with the core passage of airflow extending through the platform.

7. The airfoil structure of claim 6, further comprising a dedicated inlet passage located upstream of the core passage in the platform, the dedicated inlet passage is in fluid communication with a core airfoil source.
8. A gas turbine engine comprising:
an airfoil including a leading edge and a trailing edge; and a platform located adjacent a first end of the airfoil, and including:
9. The gas turbine engine of claim 8, further comprising an inlet located on a radially inner side of the platform axially upstream of the core passage.
10. A method of cooling an airfoil comprising:

directing cooling air through a core passage in a platform of an airfoil; directing the cooling air form the core passage through impingement passages to a set of impingement cooling holes on a mate-face of the platform.
11. The method of claim 10, wherein the cooling air is secondary leakage air.
12. The gas turbine engine or method of any of claims 8 to 11, wherein the set of impingement holes are generally axially aligned with the trailing edge of the airfoil.

13. The airfoil structure, gas turbine engine or method of any preceding claim, further comprising a set of platform film cooling holes extending through a radially outer surface of the platform adjacent the set of impingement cooling holes.
14. The airfoil structure, gas turbine engine or method of claim 13, wherein the set of platform film cooling holes are axially offset from the set of impingement cooling holes.
15. The airfoil structure, gas turbine engine or method of claim 14, wherein the set of impingement cooling holes are located in an axial downstream half of the platform.
